summary: E-Power Inc. filed Form 6-K to report the closing of a private placement of 15,841,585 Class A ordinary shares at $1.01 per share for $16.0 million gross proceeds, as previously disclosed on June 23, 2026. The shares were issued under Regulation S to a non-U.S. purchaser. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
